description: Check the payment status of a booking created by prepare_booking. Read-only and idempotent: repeat calls with the same idempotencyKey return the same state, and it creates nothing and confirms nothing by itself. Usage: call this after prepare_booking, and again after the customer reports paying, until the status is confirmed or expired. Report whether a prepared booking is confirmed by payment, still awaiting payment, or expired; it never confirms a booking itself. Once paid, it returns the Meet link, receipt link, a calendar event with ICS and stable UID, and agent instructions; it returns no management link. QConsul also emails the customer the calendar invitation; the agent reports the booking to its customer and deduplicates any calendar entry on the UID.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique key you choose for this check, e.g. a UUID. Repeat calls with the same key return the same state; use a new key only for a new check after time has passed.

prepareToken.description: The prepareToken returned by prepare_booking for the booking being checked. Required; there is no other way to look a booking up.

name: confirm_booking

bookingNumber.description: Booking number once confirmed, format QC-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXXXX.

calendar.description: Calendar payload the agent can add to its human's calendar.

uid.description: Stable calendar event UID for deduplicating entries.

holdExpiresAt.description: When an unpaid hold expires, ISO 8601 datetime.

status.description: Booking state: Booked, Cancelled, payment_pending, payment_processing, payment_failed, or expired.

title: Confirm booking status
